name: Mall Advertising Lightbox
summary: A freestanding illuminated poster frame with original geometric campaign artwork and a rear service panel.
description: A freestanding illuminated poster frame with original geometric campaign artwork and a rear service panel.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and Principled BSDF materials. Blender bundled Bfont labels are converted to mesh in the GLB. No external textures or models.
accuracy_notes: Original decorative concept, not an official mall product, a real floor map, functional touchscreen, engineering or fabrication specification. Dimensions measured from actual GLB.

attribution.credit: Original geometry and campaign artwork authored for Blender-3D-Gallery. Labels use Blender bundled Bfont, retained as editable source text and exported as geometry.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
